about_the_game:
This support pack was created for players who want to help the game's developers. Buyers will receive the official soundtrack album and a unique background on the leaderboard representing supporters.

You can support the development team by purchasing this pack, enjoy the game's original soundtrack, and stand out on the leaderboard with a special background symbolizing supporters.

You can find the in-game music in the 'Cat and Farm Pals Supporter Soundtrack Pack' folder located where the game is installed.
